title: Haydarpaşa railway station
visualBrief: Complete permanent historic U-shaped passenger building, including the whole long southeast and shorter northwest wings, open rail-side court, twin cylindrical seaward corner towers with steep slate roofs and open lanterns, main steep roof and dormers, shaped central clock gable, repeated pilasters/cornices, tall arched windows and closed glazed ground doors. Original medium-fi relief and hidden courtyard/rear opening inventory. Exclude temporary restoration scaffolding, large roof railway logo, copied lettering/sculpture, quay/rocks/water, seaward kiosk, separate rear buildings, rail infrastructure and navigable interior.

buildingCutout.basis: Q800973 and retained way/473151877 identify the historic U-shaped station passenger building. Current full principal component 35184845240709 (index45) and its two tile-edge fragments (indices28/29) share the same encoded identity and match the twin seaward towers and unequal rear wings. The small seaward strip building, quays, railway structures and independent rear buildings remain separate. Encoded IDs are not asserted to be OSM element IDs. Native 7.25m height conflicts with the clearly multi-story photographed architecture; preserve it as a conflicting map fact, not a source building height. The small southeast tile-edge fragment index29 extends fractionally outside the full generalized principal ring; its own same-ID outline is included in building replacement to suppress the duplicate. The exact occupied source floor and ground mask use the principal U-shaped ring.
